feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Iteration 1 (widened ±3 cm, 16 mm sensors, y=0.04) showed line loss of about 1.0 per run on oval, s-bend and slalom, with max_error at 0.0625 to 0.0678, so the wider span did not remove line loss (iteration 0 had 1.0 to 2.0). Steering oscillation stayed low (0.07 to 0.13), so the robot is losing the line on bends, not jittering. The Integrator kept the controller at kp 2.5, kd 0.2 and base_speed 1.5 so this change is isolated. Decision rules for the next race: (1) If line_loss_events fall to 0.5 or less on the s-bend and slalom, and max_error stays under 0.06 m, keep y=0.03 and then test whether a further change is needed. (2) If steering_oscillation rises clearly above the iteration 1 range (about 0.13 to 0.2) with the shorter offset, move y back toward 0.035 m. (3) If line_loss_events stay near 1.0 per run at y=0.03, the offset is not the limit. Then test a mass or wheel change, not a narrower span, because iteration 0 (4 cm span, y=0.05) also lost the line.
requested_changes: Keep sensor y at 0.03 m with the ±3 cm span, 10 mm spacing and 16 mm sensors. Basis: iteration 1 kept line loss near 1.0 per run at y=0.04, so the forward offset is the remaining sensing lever.
If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.2 at y=0.03, try y=0.035 m. Basis: iteration 1 oscillation was 0.07 to 0.13, so there is room before jitter becomes a problem.

If line_loss_events remain near 1.0 per run at y=0.03, try mass 0.6 kg with wheel_track 0.14 m. Basis: iterations 0 and 1 both lost the line on bends with mass 0.8 and 0.7 kg, and this is the next untested dynamics lever.
